component.name: Couch Remote
component.summary: Remote control for Android TV and Google TV

description.p: Couch Remote controls Android TV and Google TV devices on the local network from a compact GTK interface inspired by physical TV remotes.

It supports network discovery, pairing, saved device profiles, Wake-on-LAN, configurable key mappings, diagnostics, text input, app launching, and per-device button remapping for model-specific behavior.
Discovered devices now get their MAC address detected automatically, so Wake-on-LAN works without entering it by hand.
Reworked the window into a balanced two-column layout that fits smaller screens, and gave the status bar a recessed LCD-style look.
Fixed the Pair Selected button in the setup window so pairing actually starts.
Fixed pairing from the setup window.
Fixed Android TV discovery inside the Flatpak sandbox.
Updated the Flatpak application ID and manifest for Flathub submission.
Updated Flatpak packaging to use pinned offline Python dependency sources.
First stable Android TV and Google TV focused release.
